text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> RDW-API-5xx-high. Incoming 5xx spike from us-west gateways, ~1200 rps, error-rate ~18%. PagerDuty incident P-20789 created. Runbook ref: /runbooks/api-5xx

pagerbot: Auto-escalation: paging primary on-call (alex). If ack not received in 30s will escalate to rotation (samir).

alex: acked. I'm taking it. grabbing logs + tracing. tagging ops and support.

alex: quick check - curl to health returns 200 but frontend routes show 502/503 for a subset of tenants. suspect rollout or proxy config.

alex: logs tail (snippet):
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/rdw-api --tail=200 | grep -E \"ERROR|5..\" | head -n 50
[09:12:03] ERROR upstream connect failed for tenant=acme (502)
[09:12:05] ERROR timeout waiting for backend pool
[09:12:07] WARN kv-cache miss spike
```

samir: any customer-facing impact yet? which customers?

alex: initial checks show errors concentrated on routes handled by us-west gateway (gw-usw-2). Affected tenants: acme, kiosk-inc, pbx-svc (prelim). I'll confirm via trace IDs. Estimated mitigation time 10-15m.

jess: support-team, can you open incident ticket and start triage message to customers if they ping? hold public status until we have mitigation confirmed. :shield:

support-team: created INC-4321 in Zendesk and added initial notes + customer list. Will prepare templated message but holding send until we confirm mitigation.

maria: I see a rollout to rdw-api-v2 started ~09:10 in us-west with new connection pooling change.  requests/sec and backend concurrency both spiked right after. Suggest rollback to previous stable revision for us-west while we investigate pool change.

alex: agree. initiating partial rollback for us-west deployments to revert to revision 12. Patching proxy routing to avoid draining all traffic at once.

alex: rolling back: (commands)
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/rdw-api --to-revision=12 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/rdw-api --timeout=5m
```

ops-bot: Autoscaler alert: dedicated-prod-a CPU spike correlated with rdw-api-v2 pods (90% -> 98%). Possible hot tail of background batch jobs. Noted.

samir: if rollback isn't sufficient, can we route affected tenant traffic to eu-west proxies temporarily? Need to confirm SLO/regional compliance for those tenants.

alex: patching proxy config now to prefer eu-west for affected tenant IDs. Will add header X-Region-Failover for traceability.

alex: patch snippet applied:
```json
{"proxy": {"routes": [{"tenant_id": "acme", "fallback_region": "eu-west"}], "headers": {"X-Region-Failover": "eu-west"}}}
```

alex: update 09:18 - rollback progressing, ~60% of us-west pods reverted; 502 rate down ~40% compared to peak. Traces show fewer upstream timeouts.

maria: good. I'll hold the deploy freeze for rdw-api across all regions until postmortem.

support-team: starting customer outreach drafts for acme and kiosk-inc. tagging legal for any compliance notices.

jess: please also add a short note to status.redwood.ai with incident P-20789 and "under investigation". No public root cause yet.

ops-bot: Monitoring: 5xx rate by region:
- us-west: peaked 18% -> now 7%
- eu-west: baseline 0.6%
- us-east: baseline 0.4%

samir: alex, once rollback fully completes, can you confirm if KV cache misses returned to normal? That would point to connection pooling/backpressure versus app bug.

alex: will check. running KV cache stats:
```
redis-cli -h redis-prod-1 info stats | grep keyspace
# kv cache miss_rate ~0.22 at peak, now 0.03 after rollback
```

alex: update 09:24 - rollback complete in us-west. 5xx rate near baseline (1-2%). KV miss_rate back to normal. Routing fallback active for affected tenants until we lift.

support-team: notified customers via INC-4321: short update sent saying we mitigated and investigating root cause.

jess: good. please hold deploys for rdw-api and rdw-proxy until postmortem. Add release hold tag to pipelines.

maria: grabbing the failing release artifacts and the deploy diff (connection-pool patch). Will post in postmortem doc.

alex: postmortem owners: alex (incident lead), maria (deploy/release), samir (routing/infra), jess (customer comms).

pagerbot: Incident P-20789 marked: RESOLVED (auto-close in 15m if no regression). Owners assigned: alex, maria, samir.

alex: closing notes - mitigation: rollback of rdw-api-v2 in us-west + proxy region fallback. Probable root cause: aggressive connection pooling change + autoscaler/backpressure interplay. Follow-ups: detailed RCA, release freeze, stricter canary gating for connection pool changes, add KV-cache telemetry alarms.

jess: thanks team. I'll schedule a 30-min blameless postmortem slot tomorrow and loop in product and support.

support-team: will update INC-4321 with final customer note after RCA.

incident-bot: Event closed. Summary saved to /incidents/P-20789/summary.
